title: Open injective coefficients kill a restricted image
statement: Let $p:X\to S$, $g:T\to S$ be scheme morphisms with $S$ affine, $\Lambda$ a commutative ring, and $q\ge1$ an integer. Assume universal base change for $p$ in every degree $q'<q$ [sbc-def-base-change-property]. Let $F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $T_{\mathrm{et}}$, $x\in X$, and $f:T'\to T$ with $T'$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Use the canonical stalks $B(U)$, maps $b_U$ and restrictions $r_\varphi$ of [def-sbc-canonical-base-change-stalk-transitions]. Let $V\subset T'$ be a quasi-compact open, $j:V\hookrightarrow T'$, and $\zeta\in B(T')$ with $r_j(\zeta)\in\operatorname{im}(b_V)$. Put $F'=f^*F$, $J=\operatorname{Injective.under}(j^*F')$, and let $a:j^*F'\hookrightarrow J$ be the chosen injection. For $Y'=T'\times_S X$ with projections $e',h'$, the map on the geometric stalk of $R^q h'_*e'^*F'$ induced by the coefficient map $F'\to j_*J$ adjoint to $a$ sends $\zeta$ to zero.

proof.text: Form the coefficient embedding adjoint to j*F′→J. The proved library theorem baseChangeHomologyMap_comp_map_eq_zero_of_injective combines coefficient naturality with positive-degree injective acyclicity, and therefore kills the base-change image on V. The full critical-map/cokernel injectivity theorem is not needed.
Apply the open injective Leray edge monomorphism, using universal lower-degree base change after the preliminary pullback.

Coefficient naturality identifies the edge image with the restricted class followed by the injection into J. This is zero by the first step. The exact geometric fiber preserves the edge monomorphism; cancellation proves the result.
